verdict.rationale: Vanta can be driven headlessly through its token-authenticated API. It supports listing tests, documents and evidence, uploading documents, bulk actions, and pushing custom resources for Custom Tests. Official SDKs and webhooks support non-interactive automation pipelines. However, nothing in the evidence documents a CLI, a CI runner integration, or a CI usage guide, so CI use would require custom API scripting. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, documented CI integration (e.g. a GitHub Action or pipeline examples), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI automation.
